instruction: Place an amazon order as per my husband's email today.
notes: The husband's email address and work address are looked up via phone.search_contacts(relationship=husband); the email received today from him is located with gmail.show_inbox_threads(from_email, min_created_at) and read with gmail.show_thread, which yields the requested product type and budget (max price). amazon.search_products with product_type, max_price and sort_by='-rating' finds the highest-rated affordable product; it is added to the cart with quantity 1 and clear_cart_first=true so the order contains exactly one item. The husband's work address is added as a new amazon address (parsed into street/city/state/country/zip) and the order is placed with that address and an existing payment card. Static init facts (email-of, work-address-of, address-components, request-in-thread, matches-request) only link placeholder objects whose values are bound at runtime; knowledge predicates (known-email, known-work-address, found-*) gate downstream actions. supervisor.complete_task is forced last via (task-completed).
